clinical_trials.title: A Comparative Clinical Trial Evaluating the Effect and Safety of Tacrolimus Versus Hydrocortisone in Management of Atopic Dermatitis in Children
clinical_trials.brief_summary: One of the most frequent skin conditions is atopic dermatitis (AD), characterized by its pruritic inflammation effect. Where the prevalence of AD increased in the last three decades by two or three folds worldwide, especially in developed countries, AD is supposed to affect about 15% to 30% of children, and 2% to 10% of adults. This type of dermatitis is frequently linked to a family history of other atopic illnesses such as allergic rhinitis or asthma.

relevance.reasoning: Phase 2 完成，Tacrolimus vs Hydrocortisone 比較，適應症推測為異位性皮膚炎而非直接治療過敏性氣喘本身。間接支持類固醇在過敏疾病之應用，惟無法直接推論氣喘療效，且本藥未為主要研究藥物。

clinical_trials.title: SEAL (Stopping Eczema and ALlergy) Study: Prevent the Allergic March by Enhancing the Skin Barrier
clinical_trials.brief_summary: This is a randomized, controlled trial designed for children who are have already developed atopic dermatitis (AD or eczema) by 12 weeks of age. The aim is to compare the effect of proactive sequential skin care, including the twice-daily use of a tri-lipid skin barrier cream (Epiceram) and proactive use of fluticasone propionate cream, against reactive AD therapy, to reduce the occurrence and severity of AD in early infancy and thereby prevent food allergy (FA).

relevance.reasoning: Phase 2 SEAL 研究（n=398），目標為阻斷『過敏進行曲』（濕疹→氣喘），以皮膚屏障增強為主要介入，Hydrocortisone 為輔助成分。對過敏性氣喘直接治療效益無可推論，但顯示本藥物在過敏疾病預防架構中的角色。

clinical_trials.title: Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Safety Profile of Understudied Drugs
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The study investigators are interested in learning more about how drugs, that are given to children by their health care provider, act in the bodies of children and young adults in hopes to find the most safe and effective dose for children. The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the PK of understudied drugs currently being administered to children per SOC as prescribed by their treating provider.

relevance.reasoning: 大型 PK/PD 安全性研究（n=5000），涵蓋多種未充分研究藥物，非針對 intrinsic asthma 的療效試驗。Phase N/A 分類顯示為藥理學研究，不提供適應症再利用支持。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 內源性氣喘（非過敏性/阿斯匹林惡化型）與花生四烯酸代謝異常相關，對 NSAIDs 及某些添加劑敏感。兩篇直接文獻均顯示 hydrocortisone succinate 可在此族群引發嚴重支氣管痙攣，機轉可能為 SUCNR1 介導或嗜鹼性/肥大細胞直接激活，安全信號明確，無任何效益性證據對抗此風險。

clinical_trials.title: A Multicenter, Efficacy and Safety Study of Methotrexate to Increase Response Rates in Patients With Uncontrolled Gout Receiving KRYSTEXXA® (Pegloticase) (MIRROR Open-Label [OL])
clinical_trials.brief_summary: The overall objective of the study is to assess the efficacy, safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics (PK) of the concomitant use of pegloticase with methotrexate (MTX) to enhance the response rate seen with pegloticase alone in adults with uncontrolled gout.

relevance.reasoning: Phase 4 完成，主要介入藥物為 Methotrexate，n=14 樣本極小（可能為難治性痛風），與 hydrocortisone succinate 毫無關聯，不提供再利用支持，相關性評級為最低。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 皮質醇類固醇可抑制嗜中性球浸潤及 IL-1β/NLRP3 信號通路，理論上可緩解急性痛風發作；然 hydrocortisone succinate 特異性應用於痛風完全無直接臨床證據。唯一相關試驗研究 methotrexate（不同藥物），且樣本量極小（n=14）。現有預測純屬 TxGNN 知識圖譜推論，無臨床驗證基礎。
靜脈類固醇（dexamethasone）有降低偏頭痛復發率之 RCT 證據，屬藥物類效應（class effect）；hydrocortisone succinate 本身無任何直接臨床試驗或文獻，TxGNN 預測來自知識圖譜藥物-疾病相似性，機轉類推缺乏特異性驗證。
腦幹先兆偏頭痛為罕見亞型，涉及後腦循環的皮質擴散性抑制（CSD）。無任何 hydrocortisone succinate 直接或間接臨床依據，且此亞型多種血管活性藥物（triptans）為相對禁忌，安全性評估更為複雜。
子宮內膜息肉與雌激素驅動之局部增生相關。雖 GR 受體在子宮內膜有表現，且皮質醇可拮抗雌激素信號，但無已知臨床切入點；可能存在 HPA 軸抑制風險，無任何直接或間接研究支持此適應症。
聲帶息肉主要由機械性創傷引起，皮質醇可減少局部水腫，惟全身性 hydrocortisone succinate 靜脈製劑對聲帶息肉無任何臨床證據，現行標準治療為顯微手術或音聲治療。
中耳息肉通常繼發於慢性中耳炎之慢性炎症，局部類固醇滴耳液有一定應用，但 hydrocortisone succinate 靜脈製劑對此適應症無直接臨床依據，給藥途徑亦不適配局部病灶治療需求。

literature.title: [Hydrocortisone hemisuccinate treatment of ulcerative and bullous lesions in the oral mucosa].

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 牙齦瘤為牙齦局部炎症性或纖維性增生，皮質醇透過 GR 受體抑制 NF-κB 炎症通路、減少肉芽組織生成，機轉合理。1962 年文獻直接記載 hydrocortisone hemisuccinate 局部應用於口腔黏膜潰瘍/大皰性病變有效；2018 年研究開發含本藥之黏膜貼片遞送系統，驗證局部給藥可行性。雖證據古老，但藥物-疾病機轉路徑合理，局部製劑安全性高，有現代化臨床研究之空間。
